items.label: MA-AG civil: Schweb Partners LLC
items.detail: Proposed consent judgment over housing and consumer protection violations at the Springfield Gardens apartment buildings; date is the announcement date. Release states $10 million total consumer relief: $2.5 million paid to the Commonwealth plus $7.5 million of alleged unpaid rent forgiven. Principals Schmidt and Weber and related entities are left out. Amount entered is the cash only; the forgiven rent is not counted.

excluded_amounts.reason: Release: "Schweb will pay $2.5 million to the Commonwealth and forgive $7.5 million in alleged unpaid rent for impacted tenants, resulting in a total of $10 million in consumer relief." Counted: the $2.5 million. Not counted: the forgiven rent. The release calls it a proposed consent judgment subject to court approval.
